question: Which among the following festivals is celebrated in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishu** is a traditional festival celebrated in **Kerala**, which marks the** beginning of the Malayalam** calendar year.
 
• The festival usually falls in the **second week of April** and is celebrated with **great enthusiasm **across the state.
 
• On Vishu, people in Kerala decorate their houses with** flowers**, prepare **special dishes,** and offer **prayers to Lord Vishnu.**
 
• Other important festivals celebrated in Kerala include **Onam,** which is a harvest festival, and **Thrissur Pooram**, which is a grand temple festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bonalu** is a festival celebrated in **Telangana,** which is dedicated to the goddess **Mahakali.**
 
• **Baisakhi** is a festival celebrated in **Punjab** and other parts of North India, which marks the beginning of the **Sikh New Year **and the harvest season.
 
• **Ambubachi** is a festival celebrated in **Assam**, which is dedicated to the **goddess Kamakhya** and is associated with **fertility and menstruation.**
